name: Transformer protection lockout distribution
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Maps transformer protection initiations to the assigned lockout and breaker trip destinations.
description: Maps transformer protection initiations to the assigned lockout and breaker trip destinations. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Transformer protection outputs” at the input and “Assigned lockout actions” at the output. All energized transformer connections must be considered.
